purpose: Structured, mechanically-discoverable registry of 'GOVERNANCE FLAG'-style callouts raised inline in claims.yaml prose (what_would_answer / evidence_quality_note / digestion_note) or in WORKSPACE_STATE.md Recent Work, most often by /thought-digestion sessions honouring the standing rule 'flag for /governance review, do not promote or resolve yourself mid-digestion'. Before this file existed, such flags were discoverable only by a human or agent noticing distinctive wording while reading a long, ever-growing WORKSPACE_STATE.md during /governance's own Session Startup Protocol orientation step -- which works only if the flag is recent enough to still be near the top. Confirmed staleness this caused: the ARC-033 promotion flag (GFLAG-0001, raised 2026-08-06) was still unactioned a full day later; the SD-014 discrepancy flag (GFLAG-0003, raised 2026-08-06) had already been resolved by an experiment run on 2026-08-04 that a LATER session had to independently re-discover from scratch because nothing pointed it at the open flag.
authority: This file is a derive-only, human/agent-adjudicated INPUT, exactly like sibling evidence/planning/*.v1.json files (see hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json's own authority note for the pattern). It never mutates claims.yaml, closure weights, or claim status by itself -- raising or resolving a flag here is bookkeeping, not a governance decision. /governance's own interactive review (see .claude/skills/governance/SKILL.md) is where a flag's substance actually gets acted on; this registry only guarantees the flag surfaces there instead of depending on luck.

flag_type_notes.promotion_review: A claim's status looks ready to move (e.g. candidate -> provisional/stable) but the flagging session deliberately did not promote it -- promotion is /governance's call, not a digestion-pass call.
flag_type_notes.evidence_discrepancy: A numeric, terminological, or structural mismatch was noticed (e.g. a claim describing N components when the substrate or a sibling claim implies a different N) that needs reconciliation, not just a note.
flag_type_notes.stale_note: A prose note (evidence_quality_note, live_status pointer, etc.) is suspected or confirmed to be pointing at outdated evidence and needs a governance-reviewed refresh.
flag_type_notes.contested_disposition: Two sessions, or a session and the user, reached different conclusions about how a claim should be classified or routed, and the disagreement was not resolved inline.

items.summary: The confirmed 2026-08-05 autopsy (V3-EXQ-867b section 2) records the screen-soundness violation as 'direct evidence the ON-arm manipulation itself perturbs whether/when decomposition fires', and that inference is carried verbatim into claims.yaml MECH-321 evidence_quality_note + what_would_answer and into hypothesis_space_registry observation_bottleneck + resolution.basis; 867b's own manifest contradicts it -- the violation appears in the OFF arm where the manipulation is provably inert (decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero == 0 on every OFF cell), OFF-arm multi_action_commits DECREASED from the 4-episode screen to the 12-episode measurement on 5 seeds (impossible for a monotone counter over a prefix extension), and at full schedule the matching held perfectly (on_only and off_only tiers both EMPTY). ARC-004 FAILS its own registered what_would_answer, measured 2026-08-26. First execution of that falsifier -- its own text records the claim 'has never been tested as its own claim (absent from claim_evidence.v1.json) -- it is currently assumed via 36 dependents architecture, not measured'. PASS requires half-life(z_delta) > half-life(z_theta) > half-life(z_beta) by >= 0.8 SD of the seed-to-seed delta. Measured at 3 operating points, 5 seeds each (distinct stack init AND input stream), 1500 ticks: synthetic AR(1) rho=0.5 -> 1/5 seeds, margin +0.043 vs bar 0.060; rho=0.95 -> 1/5 seeds, margin +0.041 vs bar 0.653; REAL CausalGridWorld rollout -> 0/5 seeds, margin -0.159 vs bar 0.142, i.e. INVERTED (z_delta persists SHORTER than z_beta on every seed). Mechanism is transparent and read from source: alpha_shared=0.3 is a bare hardcoded literal applied identically to all three depths (stack.py:1454; note alpha_self/alpha_world ARE configurable, alpha_shared is not), and the beta->theta->delta cascade is a chain of UNTRAINED static projections (MECH-523), which change values but not temporal correlation -- so each depth inherits its input timescale under one identical EMA. White-noise control confirms: at rho=0 all three measure 1.89-1.91 against the EMA-alone prediction ln(0.5)/ln(0.7)=1.94. ARC-004's own FAIL branch prescribes the consequence: layers differ in content, not timescale; 'multi-timescale' is the wrong description of why they work; supersession review of the framing, structurally analogous to MECH-058 (asserted timescale separation for z_self/z_world, tested by lag-k autocorrelation in V3-EXQ-019, FAILED, retired, superseded by MECH-069 'incommensurable domains'). NO STATUS CHANGED HERE -- ARC-004 is active/standard with 36 dependents and this is governance's call. LIMITS, stated: encoders untrained (the as-built condition per MECH-523, and the condition ARC-004's own precondition frames, but a trained stack is untested); random-action policy on the real rollout; the 210-dim observation was split in half for body/world rather than using canonical channel routing, which should be redone before any supersession decision; the optional MECH-423 per-layer convergence corroboration was not run. SUBSTRATE DEFECT, fixed ree-v3 2b345217c7 (2026-09-03): REEAgent.offline_integration() -- the sole agent-loop entry to E1 replay for the sleep.offline_integration subject (ARC-011, INV-010) -- concatenated z_self/z_world on torch.cat's default dim=0 over [1, D] buffers, so it crashed (self_dim == world_dim: E1 matmul shape error once the buffer passed 10 entries; self_dim != world_dim: cat error), and with dim=-1 alone E1.integrate_experience() mis-stacked the [1, 2D] entries as horizon 0 and returned nan. Discovered by V3-EXQ-996 (queue-experiment session daily-20260903-exq996-gap14, Step 2.5a probe). No script under ree-v3/experiments/ ever called offline_integration() or should_integrate(), so offline_integration_frequency never had a working consumer and NO prior evidence on ARC-011/INV-010 exercised the agent-loop E1 replay; treat any claim note implying it did as stale. The V3-EXQ-996 driver works around the defect by calling only agent.residue_field.integrate() on integrate ticks -- a successor can drop that workaround and call agent.offline_integration() now that the fix and its contract (tests/contracts/test_offline_integration_cat_dim.py) are on ree-v3 main.

V3-EXQ-978 (SD-018 directional-field validation, FAIL, autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-978_2026-09-03 ratified non_contributory) carries an eval-protocol confound inside its competence DV that the autopsy did not record. The fishtank episode log (seed 42, 6 OFF + 6 ON episodes, frozen policies) shows the greedy-argmax eval reader (x737 LatentPPOEvalPolicy) falling into a deterministic two-cell limit cycle in 9 of 12 episodes; the causal-footprint contamination rule (+0.5 per visit, cell retyped contaminated at 2.0, 0.4 health per contaminated step) then kills the agent at step 11-23 in a hazard-free D3 env, so every dithering episode ends health_depleted with ~11 steps of foraging opportunity against 200. The other 3 episodes are a fixed-point wall-press (198/200 stationary). PPO trains by sampling and never experiences its own argmax cycle, which is why the reader scores 0.27 res/ep BELOW the random_walk anchor (1.05, survives ~48 steps). Consequences: (1) the arm contrast is compressed toward zero by episode truncation regardless of what z_world carries, so the OFF/ON null is weaker evidence than the manifest reads; (2) the chip-20260903-exq978-oracle-adapter-discriminator follow-on (H-B/H-C, zworld_actor_adequacy_locus) should pre-register a stochastic or contamination-off eval, or a survival-normalised DV, else the same truncation will mask the adapter contrast. Not a re-test request; INV-088/MECH-457 dispositions stand. Evidence: per-step pos/health/transition_type in the 978 episode log companion (Mac + hub copies, placemarker on origin).
